{{Quote|Zeltrons: A humanoid race native to the planet Zeltros. They are distinguished by their crimson red skin and possess the unique ability to love others unconditionally.|An excerpt from the ''Plevitz Essential Guide to Species''{{'s}} entry on Zeltrons|<ref name="One of a Kind (comic)">{{CWACite|8|One of a Kind (comic story)}}</ref>}}
Active during the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], '''Plevitz''' was a professional [[Author/Legends|author]] hired by the [[Sentientologist|anthropologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]] to write the ''[[Plevitz Essential Guide to Species]]'', a piece of reference literature that focused on several different [[Species/Legends|species]] from around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The reference literature was released prior to the completion of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and Plevitz included an entry on the [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltrons]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species known for their constant pleasure-seeking lifestyle.

==Biography==
{{Quote|While Zeltrons have little concern for military defense, they tend to keep themselves in peak physical condition.|An excerpt from ''Plevitz Essential Guide to Species''{{'s}} entry on Zeltrons|<ref name="One of a Kind (comic)" />}}
Plevitz was a professional [[Author/Legends|author]] active during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Plevitz was hired by the<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|36|Plevitz}}</ref> [[Sentientologist|senior anthropologist]]<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> [[Mammon Hoole]] to write the ''[[Plevitz Essential Guide to Species]]'',<ref name="CSWE" /> a piece of non-fiction reference literature that contained anthropological information on a variety of [[Species/Legends|species]] from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The ''Plevitz Essential Guide to Species'' was released sometime before the conclusion of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="One of a Kind">{{CWACite|8|One of a Kind}}</ref> which ended in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

In the reference literature, Plevitz included an entry on the [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltrons]], a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species famous for their crimson [[red]] skin, insouciant lifestyle, and ability to love others unreservedly. In the entry, Plevitz wrote how the Zeltrons were naturally able to release potent [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromones]] and sense the emotions of other beings. Plevitz also noted that while the Zeltrons lacked concern for any military defense of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]], they usually kept themselves physically fit. As a result, if a Zeltron found no other way to show their passion, they could become a fierce and dangerous warrior.<ref name="One of a Kind" />

==Behind the scenes==
Plevitz was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[One of a Kind (comic story)|''One of a Kind'']], when the ''Plevitz Essential Guide to Species'' was quoted a number of times throughout the comic's story. ''One of a Kind'' was published in [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 8|''Clone Wars Adventures: Volume 8'']] on [[June 20]], [[2007]]. Plevitz later received an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', released [[December 9]], [[2008]].
